subject: Unspecified parameters added to the model

messages.author: 7ab5cf5ebc423d9b
messages.subject: Unspecified parameters added to the model
parts:
Hi-

I am using lavaan to fit mixed graph SEM's where you do not explicitly model any latent variables, but simply assume dependence in the errors. However, I am finding that when I use the 'sem' function, there is an additional parameter which is being added to my model which I do not specify. For example, from the following code I get the output of ParTable which includes an additional y3 - y8 covariance term which is not specified in my model. I can see that the $user value for that particular parameter is 0 which I guess means that it was not user specified. However, I was wondering if there is a reason why that parameter is added by the sem function and how to prevent that behavior in general.

Thanks in advance for any tips!

Thanks,
Sam Wang



mod <- "y1 ~~ y1; y2 ~ y1; y2 ~~ y2; y3 ~ y2; y3 ~~ y3; y4 ~ y1; y4 ~~ y4; y5 ~ y1; y5 ~~ y3+y4+y5; y6 ~ y2+y5; y6 ~~ y1+y3+y4+y6; y7 ~ y4+y5; y7 ~~ y2+y7; y8 ~ y1+y7; y8 ~~ y5+y6+y8"
fit <- lavaan::sem(mod, data = dat, fixed.x = F, estimator = "ML")
fit@ParTable
